method.edgeSides: active cell side with no quadtree neighbour
method.outside: minimum of the 10 m context terrain outside the domain polygon in bands ((0, 100), (200, 400), (400, 600)) m outward from the cell edge, lateral width max(cell, 30 m)
method.keepsFalling: fallsOutward and each further band at least 0.2 m lower than the previous
method.clusters: union of 250 m buffers around flagged cell centres
method.channel: NHDPlus wide-fetch flowline or OSM waterway crossing the domain edge in the cluster; terrainFallsOutward when the line terrain 150-300 m outside is below that inside
